text: Herufi. Hapa tutajifunza herufi za Kiingereza.
en: Letters. Here we learn the English letters.

text: Kuandika. Hapa tutajifunza kuandika maneno ya Kiingereza, herufi kwa herufi.
en: Writing. Here we learn to write English words, letter by letter.

text: Chagua somo moja, ili usikie zaidi kuhusu somo hilo.

text: Wanyama. Somo hili linahusu wanyama mbalimbali wanaoishi karibu nasi.
en: Animals. This lesson is about the different animals that live around us.

text: Vitu vya nyumbani. Somo hili linahusu vitu tunavyotumia nyumbani.
en: Household things. This lesson is about the things used at home.

text: Mazingira. Somo hili linahusu vitu vya asili na mazingira yetu.
en: Nature. This lesson is about the things in nature and our surroundings.

text: Magari. Somo hili linahusu magari na vyombo vingine mbalimbali tunavyopanda.
en: Vehicles. This lesson is about cars and the different things we ride.

text: Shule. Somo hili linahusu vitu tunavyotumia shuleni.
en: School. This lesson is about the things we use at school.

text: Sasa tutaona picha za vitendo. Tutajifunza majina yake kwa Kiingereza.

text: Sasa tutaona picha za nguo. Tutajifunza majina yake kwa Kiingereza.

text: Kusoma. Hapa tutasoma maneno, herufi baada ya herufi, kisha neno zima.

text: Sasa, tutasoma majina ya vitu hivi kwa Kiingereza.

text: Sasa tutafanya mtihani mdogo wa maneno uliyojifunza. Utaonyeshwa neno, kisha ulisome lote.

text: Maneno mafupi. Hapa tutasoma maneno mafupi, yenye herufi tatu.
en: Short words. Here we read short, three-letter words.

text: Maneno ya wastani. Hapa tutasoma maneno yenye herufi nne na tano.
en: Medium words. Here we read four- and five-letter words.

text: Maneno marefu. Hapa tutasoma maneno marefu.
en: Long words. Here we read long words.

text: Namba. Hapa tutasoma majina ya namba kwa Kiingereza.
en: Numbers. Here we read the names of numbers in English.

text: Sasa tutafanya mtihani mdogo, ili tuhakikishe umezielewa herufi ulizojifunza.
en: Now we'll do a small test, to make sure you understood the letters you learned.

text: Mtihani mkubwa. Sema herufi zote, moja baada ya nyingine.
en: The big test. Say all the letters, one after another.

text: Mtihani wa mwisho. Herufi zitaonyeshwa zikiwa zimechanganywa, nawe uzitaje zote.

text: Hizi hapa ni herufi nne. Sikiliza na utazame.
en: Here are four letters. Listen and look.

text: Sasa utaona herufi mbili mpya za kujifunza. Hii ni hatua mpya, muhimu sana.
en: Now you'll see two new letters to learn. This is a new stage, a very important one.

text: Sasa utaona herufi nne mpya za kujifunza. Hii ni hatua mpya, muhimu sana.
en: Now you'll see four new letters to learn. This is a new stage, a very important one.

text: Sasa, sema wewe mwenyewe.
en: Now you say it yourself.

text: Jina langu ni Laila. Mimi ni rafiki yako wa kujifunza. Sasa, bonyeza kichwa changu tuanze.
en: My name is Laila. I'm your learning friend. Now press my head and we'll start.

text: Kipindi kitaisha. Kama umemaliza, bonyeza Laila. Kama sivyo, bonyeza ubao mweusi.

text: Tazama kamera.
